in_hebrew.name: Tessie
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tessie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word 'tese,' meaning 'to reap.' In Christian tradition, Tessie symbolizes the blessing of God's harvest and the fruitfulness of His blessings.
